question: Write four means of road transport.
answer: Bus; car; lorry; bicycle. Motorcycle is also listed.

source.quote: Write four means of road transport

question: Write any one importance of road signs to road users.
answer: They guide road users; help reduce traffic jams; help reduce road accidents.

source.quote: Write any one importance of road signs to road users

question: Name the three colours of the traffic lights.

source.quote: Name the three colours of the traffic lights

question: Write the meaning of the traffic lights: red, orange and green.
answer: Red: stop. Orange: get ready. Green: go.

source.quote: Write the meaning of the traffic lights

question: Write down any two good ways of using the road.
answer: Use a zebra crossing; use footpaths. Obeying traffic rules and not running are also in the notes.

source.quote: Write down any two good ways of using the road
